    Realization of pairs with an infinite half-word #

    Shifting a pair of half-words across the first letter of an infinite side preserves the vanishing of its pair functor (shift_le_iff). A nonzero pair functor forces both sides into the finite supports of the dimension formula, so iterating the shift gives:

    • a nonzero pair never has exactly one infinite side (le_of_inf_fin);
    • a nonzero pair of infinite half-words is the pair at the first position of a primitive band (exists_band).
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.MonomialData.Signs.valid_inf_facts {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) {v : D.Q.V} {s : Bool} {f : ℕ → Letter D.Q} (hv : S.Valid v s (HWord.inf f)) :
    (f 0).src = v ∧ S.st (f 0) = s ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), (f (i + 1)).src = (f i).tgt ∧ S.st (f (i + 1)) = !S.en (f i)

    The letters of a valid infinite half-word form a walk with alternating signs.

    theorem BrickAccessibility.MonomialData.Signs.shift_le_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (M : Type u_1) [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k B M] [FiniteDimensional k M] {v : D.Q.V} {s : Bool} {f : ℕ → Letter D.Q} {h' : HWord D.Q} (hv : S.Valid v s (HWord.inf f)) (hv' : S.Valid v (!s) h') :
    S.pnum M v s (HWord.inf f) h' ≤ S.pden M v s (HWord.inf f) h' ↔ S.pnum M (f 0).tgt (!S.en (f 0)) (HWord.inf fun (i : ℕ) => f (i + 1)) (HWord.cons (f 0).inv h') ≤ S.pden M (f 0).tgt (!S.en (f 0)) (HWord.inf fun (i : ℕ) => f (i + 1)) (HWord.cons (f 0).inv h')
